question: Changsang dance is performed by the Chang tribe from ___________ during Naknyukum festivals.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Nagaland__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Changsang Dance**

 
 
• **Nagaland**, popularly referred to as** "The Land of Festivals,"** is a small, hilly state in India's northeast.
 
• Various **ethnic tribes of Naga** refers it as their home.
 
• **Nagas **hold annual festivities all year long.
 
• Naga culture places a strong emphasis on** music and dancing**.
 
• The **Chang Naga Tribe of Nagaland performs the Changsang dance** as a part of the Naknyulüm festival in the month of July.
 
• Changsang dance is performed to **honour the environment** and the site where humanity originated.
 
• During the festival with which the dance is associated, **prayers are performed side by side with the dance in order to honour the sky God**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Chang Nagas perform dances in **colourful clothes** and accompany them with matching tunes during the **Puanglem/Nknyulum festival time**.
 
• In addition to it, the **Phom Nagas** perform the **Monyu Asho dance**, a traditional folk dance, during the **Phom Monyu festival**, the largest festival of the Phom Naga tribe.
 
• The festival is celebrated in **April**.
